jobs.title: Consumer Communications Director
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (three currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for an accomplished editorial and marketing leader to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

We are seeking a highly skilled and Gen-AI savvy Consumer Communications Director to shape how our brand is experienced through language. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for delivering a distinctive, consistent, and elevated brand voice across all content, overseeing copy development with final editorial responsibility, and driving impactful onboard marketing that elevates the guest experience and drives commercial performance.

Your Impact

- Editorial leadership & tone of voice: Establish and own the brand editorial standard. Translate complex hospitality offerings into clear, emotionally engaging messaging that elevates perceived value. Bring a talent for making the long or unclear short, simple and impactful, ensuring every word reflects the elegance, warmth and exclusivity of a luxury hospitality brand with a consistent tone of voice. Maintain copy frameworks, messaging guidelines, and tone-of-voice documentation.

- Creative writing and storytelling at scale: Lead the development of clear, compelling and brand-aligned copy across all channels and touchpoints. Oversee and write high-quality content including brand stories, destination narratives and hospitality experiences, subsequently scaling this across channels and audiences, meeting the specific requirements of each touchpoint.

- Editorial responsibility and proofreading: Establish rigorous quality standards and processes and personally sign off every single piece of consumer-facing copy to meet the brand’s editorial standards, ensuring clarity, grammatical accuracy and stylistic consistency, adjusted for differentiated channels, audiences and situations.

- Onboard marketing: Lead the onboard marketing team, owning content and copy strategy, ensuring all communication enhances the guest experience and supports the delivery of onboard revenue targets. Develop clear and compelling messaging across onboard channels including e.g. printed in-suite materials, digital screens, App content and in-suite TV content.

- Copywriter network management: oversee and continuously optimise the external copywriter network, ensuring consistent quality, speed, cost efficiency and flexible capacity to meet business needs. Brief and guide copywriters to deliver consistent messaging and tone of voice, with content tailored to each channel and audience. Proactively manage the resource and supplier mix, bringing in new talent and capabilities where required and transitioning out suppliers that no longer meet business needs. Maintain a scalable network that can adapt to changing priorities and accommodate significant, periodic increases in volume without compromising quality or timely delivery.

- AI amplification to deliver scale and speed: use and champion the responsible use of Gen-AI and emerging tools to increase creative scale, speed and efficiency across the copy lifecycle—from ideation and drafting to editing, adaptation and optimisation. Combine technology with impeccable human taste, editorial judgment and brand stewardship to ensure AI-enabled content consistently meets brand standards.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in journalism, communications, English, media or a related field

- 10+ years of editorial, copywriting, journalism, communications or brand storytelling experience, with substantial exposure to travel, cruise, luxury or destination content

- Native English speaker a non-negotiable must, native British English speaker strongly preferred

Your Essentials

- Exceptional command of English writing, editing, and proofreading.

- Outstanding leadership, coaching and people development skills. Excellent collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation. Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment. Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence.

- Excellent storytelling skills, with a refined aesthetic sensibility and understanding of luxury brand positioning. A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated, persuasive, and brand-sensitive copy.

- Demonstrated flexibility to adapt content for different audiences (e.g. B2B vs B2C) and different channels (e.g. Press releases, speeches, Customer Service FAQs, In-suite letters, with proven experience writing for digital platforms) while maintaining brand integrity.

- Proven experience prompting AI tools and creating AI agents for ideation, content creation, and editing to augment capacity and increase output, while keeping strong editorial judgment over final copy

- Familiarity with GEO & SEO copywriting principles

- Deep appreciation for luxury hospitality, travel experiences, and high-end service culture. Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever evolving and luxury travel industry.

- Self-learner, continuously testing and learning with creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (tre attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformerà e ridefinirà l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'emozionante opportunità per un leader editoriale e di marketing realizzato per unire il nostro nuovo marchio di viaggio di lusso Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, in Svizzera.

Siamo alla ricerca di un direttore di comunicazioni di consumo esperto e Gen-AI per modellare come il nostro marchio è vissuto attraverso la lingua. Si tratta di un ruolo di leadership strategica responsabile per la fornitura di una voce distintiva, coerente e elevata del marchio su tutti i contenuti, supervisionando lo sviluppo della copia con responsabilità editoriale finale, e guidando il marketing a bordo che eleva l'esperienza degli ospiti e guida le prestazioni commerciali.

Il tuo impatto

- Leader editoriale & tono di voce: Stabilire e possedere lo standard editoriale del marchio. Traduci offerte di ospitalità complesse in messaggistica chiara, emotivamente coinvolgente che eleva valore percepito. Portare un talento per rendere il lungo o poco chiaro corto, semplice e impattante, assicurando ogni parola riflette l'eleganza, il calore e l'esclusività di un marchio di ospitalità di lusso con un tono coerente di voce. Mantenere i quadri di copia, le linee guida di messaggistica e la documentazione di tono di voce.

- Scrittura creativa e storytelling in scala: portare lo sviluppo di una copia chiara, convincente e allineata al marchio su tutti i canali e punti di contatto. Superare e scrivere contenuti di alta qualità tra cui storie di marca, narrazioni di destinazione e esperienze di ospitalità, successivamente scalare questo attraverso canali e pubblico, soddisfare le esigenze specifiche di ogni touchpoint.

- Responsabilità editoriale e correzione delle prove: stabilire standard e processi di qualità rigorosi e firmare personalmente ogni singolo pezzo di copia rivolto al consumatore per soddisfare gli standard editoriali del marchio, garantire chiarezza, accuratezza grammaticale e coerenza stilistica, regolata per canali differenziati, pubblico e situazioni.

- Marketing a bordo: guidare il team di marketing a bordo, possedere contenuti e strategia di copia, assicurando che tutta la comunicazione migliora l'esperienza degli ospiti e supporta la consegna di obiettivi di reddito a bordo. Sviluppare messaggi chiari e convincenti attraverso i canali di bordo, tra cui ad esempio materiali stampati in-suite, schermi digitali, contenuti App e contenuti TV in-suite.

- Gestione della rete di copywriter: supervisionare e ottimizzare continuamente la rete di copywriter esterno, garantendo qualità, velocità, efficienza dei costi e capacità flessibile per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali. Breve e guida copywriters per fornire messaggistica coerente e tono di voce, con contenuti su misura per ogni canale e pubblico. Gestire in modo attivo il mix di risorse e fornitori, portando nuovi talenti e funzionalità dove richiesto e transizione fornitori che non soddisfano più le esigenze aziendali. Mantenere una rete scalabile che può adattarsi alle mutevoli priorità e ospitare significativi, aumenti periodici di volume senza compromettere la qualità o la consegna tempestiva.

- L'amplificazione AI per fornire scala e velocità: utilizzare e sostenere l'uso responsabile di Gen-AI e strumenti emergenti per aumentare la scala creativa, la velocità e l'efficienza attraverso il ciclo di vita della copia, dall'ideazione e dalla redazione alla modifica, adattamento e ottimizzazione. Combina la tecnologia con il gusto umano impeccabile, il giudizio editoriale e la gestione del marchio per garantire il contenuto AI-enabled coerentemente soddisfa gli standard del marchio.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Corso di laurea o Master in giornalismo, comunicazioni, inglese, media o un campo correlato

- 10+ anni di esperienza editoriale, copywriting, giornalismo, comunicazione o brand storytelling, con esposizione sostanziale ai contenuti di viaggio, crociera, lusso o destinazione

- madrelingua inglese un must non negoziabile, madrelingua inglese fortemente preferito

I tuoi essenziali

- Comando eccezionale di scrittura, editing e correzione inglese.

- Competenze di leadership, coaching e sviluppo delle persone. Ottima collaborazione e capacità di influenzare, con comprovata capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione di matrice. Strutturato, ben organizzato, orientato ai dettagli, e in grado di gestire più progetti, prosperando in un ambiente di avvio veloce e veloce. Prove capacità di roll-up le maniche ed eseguire con eccellenza.

- Eccellente capacità di narrazione, con una raffinata sensibilità estetica e comprensione del posizionamento del marchio di lusso. Un portafoglio forte che dimostra una copia sofisticata, persuasa e sensibile al marchio.

- Dimostrata flessibilità per adattare i contenuti per diversi utenti (ad esempio B2B vs B2C) e diversi canali (ad esempio comunicati stampa, discorsi, FAQ del Servizio Clienti, Lettere In-suite, con comprovata esperienza di scrittura per piattaforme digitali) pur mantenendo l'integrità del marchio.

- Esperienza comprovata che spinge gli strumenti AI e la creazione di agenti AI per ideazione, creazione di contenuti, e la modifica per aumentare la capacità e aumentare la produzione, mantenendo forte giudizio editoriale su copia finale

- Familiarità con i principi di copywriting GEO & SEO

- Profondo apprezzamento per l'ospitalità di lusso, le esperienze di viaggio e la cultura di servizio di fascia alta. Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente il settore dei viaggi in continua evoluzione e lusso.

- Autoapprendimento, test e apprendimento continuo con tecnologie creative e flussi di lavoro assistiti da AI.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Entdecken Sie Ihre Reise ins Außergewöhnliche.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (drei derzeit in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Eine spannende Gelegenheit für einen erfahrenen Redaktions- und Marketingleiter besteht darin, sich unserer neu geschaffenen Luxusreisemarke Explora Journeys anzuschließen, die in unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, ansässig ist.

Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten und Gen-AI versierten Consumer Communications Director, um zu gestalten, wie unsere Marke durch Sprache erlebt wird. Dies ist eine strategische Führungsrolle, die dafür verantwortlich ist, eine unverwechselbare, konsistente und erhöhte Markenstimme über alle Inhalte hinweg zu liefern, die Kopierentwicklung mit der endgültigen redaktionellen Verantwortung zu überwachen und ein wirkungsvolles Onboard-Marketing voranzutreiben, das das Gästeerlebnis erhöht und die kommerzielle Leistung fördert.

Ihre Wirkung

- Redaktionelle Führung & Ton of Voice: Etablieren und besitzen Sie den redaktionellen Standard der Marke. Übersetzen Sie komplexe Hospitality-Angebote in klare, emotional ansprechende Nachrichten, die den wahrgenommenen Wert erhöhen. Bringen Sie ein Talent mit, um das Lange oder Unklare kurz, einfach und wirkungsvoll zu machen, um sicherzustellen, dass jedes Wort die Eleganz, Wärme und Exklusivität einer Luxus-Hospitality-Marke mit einem konsistenten Tonfall widerspiegelt. Pflegen Sie Kopier-Frameworks, Messaging-Richtlinien und Ton-of-Voice-Dokumentation.

- Kreatives Schreiben und Storytelling in großem Maßstab: Führen Sie die Entwicklung einer klaren, überzeugenden und markenorientierten Kopie über alle Kanäle und Touchpoints hinweg. Überwachen und schreiben Sie qualitativ hochwertige Inhalte, einschließlich Markengeschichten, Destination Narrative und Hospitality-Erlebnisse, skalieren Sie diese anschließend über Kanäle und Zielgruppen hinweg und erfüllen Sie die spezifischen Anforderungen jedes Touchpoints.

- Redaktionelle Verantwortung und Korrekturlesen: Etablieren Sie strenge Qualitätsstandards und -prozesse und unterschreiben Sie persönlich jedes einzelne Stück verbraucherorientierter Kopie, um die redaktionellen Standards der Marke zu erfüllen und Klarheit, grammatikalische Genauigkeit und stilistische Konsistenz zu gewährleisten, angepasst an differenzierte Kanäle, Zielgruppen und Situationen.

- Onboard-Marketing: Führen Sie das Onboard-Marketing-Team, besitzen Sie die Inhalts- und Kopierstrategie und stellen Sie sicher, dass die gesamte Kommunikation das Gästeerlebnis verbessert und die Umsetzung der Onboard-Umsatzziele unterstützt. Entwickeln Sie klare und überzeugende Nachrichten über Onboard-Kanäle, einschließlich gedruckter In-Suite-Materialien, digitaler Bildschirme, App-Inhalte und In-Suite-TV-Inhalte.

- Copywriter-Netzwerkmanagement: Überwachung und kontinuierliche Optimierung des externen Copywriter-Netzwerks, um eine konsistente Qualität, Geschwindigkeit, Kosteneffizienz und flexible Kapazität zur Erfüllung der Geschäftsanforderungen zu gewährleisten. Kurze und leitfaden für texter, um konsistentes messaging und ton der stimme zu liefern, mit inhalten, die auf jeden kanal und jedes publikum zugeschnitten sind. Verwalten Sie den Ressourcen- und Lieferantenmix proaktiv, bringen Sie bei Bedarf neue Talente und Fähigkeiten ein und wechseln Sie Lieferanten aus, die die Geschäftsanforderungen nicht mehr erfüllen. Pflegen Sie ein skalierbares Netzwerk, das sich an sich ändernde Prioritäten anpassen und signifikante, periodische Volumensteigerungen berücksichtigen kann, ohne die Qualität oder die rechtzeitige Lieferung zu beeinträchtigen.

- KI-Amplifikation, um Skalierung und Geschwindigkeit zu liefern: Verwenden und Verfechten Sie den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz von Gen-AI und neuen Tools, um die kreative Skalierung, Geschwindigkeit und Effizienz über den gesamten Kopierlebenszyklus hinweg zu erhöhen - von der Ideenfindung und dem Entwurf bis hin zur Bearbeitung, Anpassung und Optimierung. Kombinieren Sie Technologie mit tadellosem menschlichen Geschmack, redaktionellem Urteilsvermögen und Markenverantwortung, um sicherzustellen, dass KI-fähige Inhalte konsistent den Markenstandards entsprechen.

Deine Reise bisher

- Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Journalismus, Kommunikation, Englisch, Medien oder einem verwandten Bereich

- 10+ Jahre Redaktions-, Text-, Journalismus-, Kommunikations- oder Brand Storytelling-Erfahrung, mit erheblicher Exposition gegenüber Reise-, Kreuzfahrt-, Luxus- oder Zielinhalten

- Englischer Muttersprachler ein nicht verhandelbares Muss, britischer Muttersprachler stark bevorzugt

Ihre Essentials

- Außergewöhnliche Beherrschung des englischen Schreibens, Bearbeitens und Korrekturlesens.

- Herausragende Führungs-, Coaching- und Personalentwicklungsfähigkeiten. Hervorragende Zusammenarbeit und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation zu navigieren. Strukturiert, gut organisiert, detailorientiert und in der Lage, mehrere Projekte zu verwalten, die in einer schnelllebigen Start-up-Umgebung gedeihen. Bewährte Fähigkeit, Ihre Ärmel hochzukrempeln und mit Exzellenz auszuführen.

- Ausgezeichnete Storytelling-Fähigkeiten, mit einer raffinierten ästhetischen Sensibilität und Verständnis für die Positionierung von Luxusmarken. Ein starkes Portfolio, das eine anspruchsvolle, überzeugende und markensensible Kopie zeigt.

- Demonstrierte Flexibilität bei der Anpassung von Inhalten an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen (z. B. B2B vs. B2C) und verschiedene Kanäle (z. B. Pressemitteilungen, Reden, FAQs für den Kundenservice, In-Suite-Briefe, mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung beim Schreiben für digitale Plattformen) bei gleichzeitiger Wahrung der Markenintegrität.

- Bewährte Erfahrung, die KI-Tools anregt und KI-Agenten für Ideation, Content-Erstellung und Bearbeitung zur Erweiterung der Kapazität und Steigerung der Leistung erstellt, während das redaktionelle Urteilsvermögen über die endgültige Kopie gewahrt bleibt

- Vertrautheit mit GEO & SEO Copywriting Prinzipien

- Tiefe Wertschätzung für luxuriöse Gastfreundschaft, Reiseerlebnisse und High-End-Service-Kultur. Leidenschaft und Neugier, sich ständig über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde und luxuriöse Reisebranche zu informieren.

- Selbstlerner, kontinuierlich testen und lernen mit kreativen Technologien und KI-unterstützten Workflows.

Bei Explora Journeys definieren wir Luxus-Ozeanreisen neu - wo Entdeckung, Wohlbefinden und ein tiefer Respekt für die Meere in Harmonie zusammenkommen.
Wir suchen leidenschaftliche Profis, die unsere Vision von einer immersiveren, transformativeren Art und Weise teilen, die inspirierendsten Reiseziele der Welt auf dem Seeweg zu entdecken.
Bist du bereit, deine Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf Explora Journeys, wo ein Ozean von Möglichkeiten wartet. Ihre Reise zum Ocean State of Mind beginnt hier.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Découvrez votre voyage dans l'extraordinaire.

Votre but

Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (trois actuellement en oléoduc) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Une opportunité passionnante s'offre à un chef de file de l'édition et du marketing pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur des communications avec les consommateurs hautement qualifié et averti de Gen-AI pour façonner l'expérience de notre marque par le langage. Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership stratégique qui consiste à offrir une voix de marque distinctive, cohérente et élevée dans tout le contenu, à superviser le développement de la copie avec la responsabilité éditoriale finale et à stimuler le marketing à bord qui augmente l'expérience des invités et stimule la performance commerciale.

Votre impact

- Leadership éditorial & tonalité de la voix : établir et posséder la norme éditoriale de la marque. Traduisez des offres d'hospitalité complexes en messages clairs et stimulants qui élèvent la valeur perçue. Apportez un talent pour rendre le court, le simple et l'impact long ou flou, en assurant que chaque mot reflète l'élégance, la chaleur et l'exclusivité d'une marque d'hospitalité de luxe avec un ton de voix cohérent. Tenir à jour les cadres de copie, les lignes directrices de messagerie et la documentation sur le ton de la voix.

- L'écriture créative et la narration à l'échelle : Dirigez le développement de copies claires, convaincantes et alignées sur la marque sur tous les canaux et points de contact. Surveiller et rédiger des contenus de haute qualité, y compris des histoires de marque, des récits de destination et des expériences d'accueil, puis les mettre à l'échelle des canaux et des publics, en respectant les exigences spécifiques de chaque point de contact.

- Responsabilité éditoriale et relecture: Établir des normes et des processus de qualité rigoureux et signer personnellement chaque morceau de copie orientée vers le consommateur pour répondre aux normes éditoriales de la marque, en assurant la clarté, la précision grammaticale et la cohérence stylistique, ajustés pour des canaux, publics et situations différenciés.

- Marketing embarqué : Diriger l'équipe marketing embarquée, posséder du contenu et une stratégie de copie, s'assurer que toute communication améliore l'expérience des clients et soutient la réalisation des objectifs de revenus embarqués. Élaborer des messages clairs et convaincants à travers les canaux embarqués, y compris les documents imprimés dans la suite, les écrans numériques, le contenu de l'application et le contenu de télévision dans la suite.

- Gestion du réseau de copieur : superviser et optimiser en permanence le réseau externe de copieur, en assurant une qualité, une rapidité, un rapport coût-efficacité et une capacité flexible pour répondre aux besoins des entreprises. jobs.title: Manager, Cruise Development and Execution
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Turn approved deployment plans into executable, commercially ready cruise itineraries. Drawing on your seagoing experience as a Chief Officer and your knowledge of our ships and ports, you will build detailed cruise schedules and ensure their accurate setup in planning, commercial and booking systems, supporting a smooth transition from itinerary development to sale opening and operational delivery.

Your Impact

-
Execute detailed cruise itineraries based on approved deployment plans and the port availability and requirements provided by your manager, who leads port relations and availability coordination.

-
Match MSC ships to suitable ports, taking into account vessel characteristics, nautical restrictions, port infrastructure and operational requirements.

-
Build feasible cruise schedules, arrival and departure times, turnaround requirements and time available for shore experiences.

-
Create and maintain itineraries in relevant commercial and booking systems, ensuring accurate and consistent ship assignments, port sequences, dates and timings.

-
Translate confirmed port information and operational constraints into itinerary updates, coordinating changes with the relevant teams.

-
Work closely with Planning, Ports, Maritime, Revenue, Commercial, Marketing, Shore Excursions and IT to ensure itineraries are correctly configured and ready for sale.

-
Track outstanding information, approvals and system dependencies; escalate feasibility issues or readiness gaps and follow corrective actions through to resolution.

-
Prepare accurate itinerary documentation and support operational handover, ensuring teams have the information needed to deliver the planned cruise.

-
Review itinerary performance and operational feedback to improve future schedules and reduce setup errors.

Your Journey so far

-
Previous seagoing experience as a Chief Officer is mandatory.

-
Strong practical knowledge of cruise itinerary planning, port operations and vessel operating requirements.

-
Knowledge of MSC ships and itineraries, including the operational suitability of individual vessels for specific ports.

-
Experience translating nautical and operational constraints into feasible voyage schedules.

-
Experience working with detailed planning data and coordinating implementation across multiple functions.

-
A qualification in Maritime Studies, Nautical Science or a related discipline.

Your Essentials

-
Ability to assess ship–port compatibility, sailing-time feasibility and port-call requirements.

-
Strong attention to detail when creating, checking and updating itinerary data.

-
Proficiency in itinerary planning and commercial or booking systems; familiarity with DTS is an advantage.

-
Strong coordination, problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and follow actions through to completion.

-
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Performance and Optimisation
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

As Performance and Optimization Manager, you will drive commercial performance across the fleet by transforming complex data into strategic insights and actionable recommendations.

Working closely with Deployment, Revenue Management, Commercial Planning and Finance teams, you will assess the commercial and financial effectiveness of itineraries and deployment strategies, identifying opportunities to maximize revenue, profitability and guest value.
Through advanced analytics and performance evaluation, you will support critical business decisions, uncover growth opportunities and contribute to the continuous optimization of MSC Cruises' commercial strategy in a dynamic and competitive global environment.

Your Impact

- Develop driver-based performance and economic models linking deployment and itinerary choices to revenue potential, operating costs, fuel and emissions, port costs, asset utilization and overall contribution.

- Monitor performance by ship, itinerary, deployment pattern, region and season, using consistent and governed KPIs.

- Identify performance gaps, root causes and quantified optimization opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations for deployment and itinerary decisions.

- Develop forward-looking indicators and early-warning mechanisms to identify profitability risks, capacity imbalances and optimization opportunities before they materialize.

- Support scenario evaluation and post-implementation reviews comparing expected vs. realized economic impact and identifying lessons for future deployment decisions.

- Partner with Finance and Revenue Management to ensure consistency of assumptions, metric definitions, attribution methodology and benefit validation.

- Benchmark itinerary and deployment performance across ships, regions and seasons, identifying scalable best practices and structural improvement opportunities.

- Maintain a quantified deployment optimization opportunity pipeline, tracking expected value, ownership, implementation and realized benefits.

- Decision rights: owns KPI definitions and analytical standards; recommends priorities and validates benefits with Finance.

- Core outputs: scorecard, opportunity pipeline, root-cause analyses, test plans, benchmarks and benefit tracking.

- Success measures: incremental revenue or margin, conversion and spend improvement, forecast accuracy, action closure and adoption.

Your Journey so far

- Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Hospitality, Marketing or related field.

- 5-8 years of relevant commercial analytics, revenue management, onboard revenue, performance improvement

- Strong Power BI experience

- Strong understanding of guest behavior, revenue drivers, conversion, yield and service profitability.

- Proven ability to turn analysis into interventions and validate financial impact.

- Fluent English.

Your Essentials

- Advanced SQL, business intelligence, statistical analysis or comparable tools.

- Python advantageous.

- Swiss national or right to work in Switzerland is mandatory.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager is responsible for developing and executing the retail activation strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys, with the objective of increasing guest engagement, driving boutique traffic and supporting commercial performance.

The role creates and manages the onboard retail activation calendar, including events, micro-events, brand animations, VIP experiences and local initiatives designed to enhance the guest journey and maximize retail opportunities.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, onboard teams, CRM, Marketing and luxury brand partners, the role transforms retail strategies into memorable experiences that generate customer engagement, conversion and loyalty.

Your Impact

Retail Activation Strategy

- Define and manage the global retail activation framework across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Develop an annual activation calendar aligned with commercial priorities, seasonality, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Create initiatives that drive boutique traffic, customer engagement, and sales performance.

- Balance major events with agile onboard activations.

- Ensure all activations reflect the positioning of each brand.

Event & Experience Management

- Develop and execute onboard retail events, including product launches, brand showcases, VIP experiences, collection previews, and seasonal activations.

- Manage event concepts, timelines, logistics, and execution.

- Partner with luxury brands to leverage expertise, ambassadors, and activation resources.

- Measure event performance and implement improvements.

Traffic Generation & Commercial Activation

- Develop initiatives that increase boutique visitation and customer engagement.

- Create activation plans around new products, hero items, seasonal moments, itineraries, guest segments, and special occasions.

- Partner with Retail Operations to convert activations into commercial results.

- Introduce innovative approaches to attract diverse guest profiles.

VIP & Client Engagement

- Develop VIP engagement strategies with CRM and onboard teams.

- Create personalized retail experiences for high value guests.

- Support clienteling initiatives, including private appointments, exclusive previews, tailored product recommendations, and luxury brand experiences.

- Strengthen guest loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.

Local & Destination Based Activations

- Develop activations tailored to destinations, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Build partnerships with relevant local stakeholders where appropriate.

- Adapt activation strategies to regional opportunities.

- Integrate destination storytelling into retail experiences.

Brand Partner Collaboration

- Partner with luxury and premium brands to deliver joint activations and events.

- Manage brand participation and execution standards onboard.

- Ensure alignment between brand objectives and MSC / Explora commercial priorities.

- Coordinate all required brand assets and activation requirements.

Content & Communication Coordination

- Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and onboard teams to maximize activation visibility.

- Support the development of invitations, digital communications, onboard announcements, guest messaging, and promotional materials.

- Ensure consistent storytelling across all guest touchpoints.

Performance Measurement

- Define and track KPIs including attendance, traffic, sales uplift, conversion, engagement, and VIP participation.

- Analyze results and continuously optimize activation strategies.

- Share best practices and successful initiatives across the fleet.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with the VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training, and onboard leadership teams.

- Ensure retail activations support broader commercial and guest experience objectives.

Your Journey so far

- 7+ years of experience in retail marketing, luxury events, client engagement or experiential marketing.

- Experience within luxury retail, travel retail, hospitality or premium brands.

- Proven experience creating and executing customer engagement initiatives.

- Strong experience managing events, partnerships and commercial activations.

- Experience working with luxury brands and VIP clientele is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Strong understanding of luxury customer experience and experiential retail.

- Excellent project management and event execution skills.

- Strong commercial mindset with ability to link activation to business results.

- Creative thinker with ability to develop engaging concepts.

- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple projects in an international environment.

- Strong understanding of CRM, clienteling and customer engagement principles.

- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il meglio delle vostre avventure è quello che dovete ancora navigare!

Il tuo scopo

Il Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager è responsabile per lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione della strategia di attivazione al dettaglio attraverso MSC Crociere e Explora Viaggi, con l'obiettivo di aumentare il coinvolgimento degli ospiti, guidare il traffico boutique e sostenere le prestazioni commerciali.

Il ruolo crea e gestisce il calendario di attivazione al dettaglio di bordo, inclusi eventi, micro eventi, animazioni di marca, esperienze VIP e iniziative locali progettate per migliorare il viaggio degli ospiti e massimizzare le opportunità di vendita al dettaglio.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con Retail Leadership, Categoria Manager, team di bordo, CRM, Marketing e partner di brand di lusso, il ruolo trasforma le strategie di vendita al dettaglio in esperienze memorabili che generano impegno del cliente, conversione e fedeltà.

Il tuo impatto

Strategia di attivazione al dettaglio

- Definire e gestire il quadro globale di attivazione al dettaglio in MSC Crociere e Explora Viaggi.

- Sviluppare un calendario di attivazione annuale allineato con priorità commerciali, stagionalità, itinerari e profili degli ospiti.

- Creare iniziative che guidano il traffico boutique, l'impegno del cliente e le prestazioni di vendita.

- Equilibrio eventi importanti con attivazioni agili a bordo.

- Assicurarsi che tutte le attivazioni riflettano il posizionamento di ogni marchio.

Gestione eventi e esperienze

- Sviluppare ed eseguire eventi di vendita al dettaglio a bordo, tra cui lanci di prodotto, vetrine di marca, esperienze VIP, anteprime di raccolta e attivazioni stagionali.

- Gestisci concetti di eventi, timeline, logistica ed esecuzione.

- Partner con marchi di lusso per sfruttare competenze, ambasciatori e risorse di attivazione.

- Misura le prestazioni degli eventi e implementa i miglioramenti.

Generazione del traffico e attivazione commerciale

- Sviluppare iniziative che aumentano le visite boutique e l'impegno dei clienti.

- Creare piani di attivazione intorno a nuovi prodotti, oggetti di eroe, momenti stagionali, itinerari, segmenti ospiti e occasioni speciali.

- Partner con Retail Operations per convertire le attivazioni in risultati commerciali.

- Introdurre approcci innovativi per attirare diversi profili degli ospiti.

VIP & Customer Engagement

- Sviluppare strategie di coinvolgimento VIP con CRM e team di bordo.

- Crea esperienze di vendita al dettaglio personalizzate per gli ospiti di alto valore.

- Sostenere iniziative di clientela, tra cui appuntamenti privati, anteprime esclusive, raccomandazioni su misura del prodotto e esperienze di lusso del marchio.

- Rafforzare la fedeltà degli ospiti e incoraggiare gli acquisti ripetuti.

Attivazioni locali e locali

- Sviluppare attivazioni su misura per destinazioni, itinerari e profili degli ospiti.

- Costruire partenariati con le parti interessate locali pertinenti, se del caso.

- Adapt strategie di attivazione per le opportunità regionali.

- Integrare la narrazione di destinazione in esperienze di vendita al dettaglio.

Collaborazione di partner di marca

- Partner con marchi di lusso e premium per offrire attivazioni ed eventi congiunti.

- Gestisci gli standard di partecipazione e esecuzione del marchio a bordo.

- Assicurare l'allineamento tra obiettivi di marca e priorità commerciali MSC / Explora.

- Coordinare tutte le attività del marchio richieste e i requisiti di attivazione.

Coordinamento dei contenuti e delle comunicazioni

- Collabora con i team Marketing, CRM e onboard per massimizzare la visibilità dell'attivazione.

- Sostenere lo sviluppo di inviti, comunicazioni digitali, annunci di bordo, messaggistica degli ospiti e materiali promozionali.

- Assicurare una narrazione coerente in tutti i punti di contatto degli ospiti.

Misura delle prestazioni

- Definire e tracciare i KPI tra cui partecipazione, traffico, aumento delle vendite, conversione, impegno e partecipazione VIP.

- Analizzare i risultati e ottimizzare continuamente le strategie di attivazione.

- Condividi le migliori pratiche e le iniziative di successo in tutta la flotta.

Collaborazione funzionale trasversale

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di leadership VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training e onboard.

- Assicurarsi che le attivazioni di vendita al dettaglio supportino obiettivi commerciali e di esperienza degli ospiti più ampi.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 7+ anni di esperienza nel marketing al dettaglio, eventi di lusso, impegno del cliente o marketing esperienziale.

- Esperienza all'interno di lusso retail, vendita al dettaglio di viaggio, ospitalità o marchi premium.

- Provate la creazione e l'esecuzione di iniziative di customer engagement.

- Forte esperienza nella gestione di eventi, partnership e attivazioni commerciali.

- Esperienza di lavoro con marchi di lusso e clientela VIP è altamente auspicabile

I tuoi essenziali

- Forte comprensione dell'esperienza del cliente di lusso e della vendita al dettaglio esperienziale.

- Eccellente gestione del progetto e capacità di esecuzione degli eventi.

- Forte mentalità commerciale con la capacità di collegare l'attivazione ai risultati aziendali.

- Pensatore creativo con la capacità di sviluppare concetti coinvolgenti.

- Forte capacità di gestione e collaborazione degli stakeholder.

- Eccellente capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli.

- Capacità di gestire più progetti in un ambiente internazionale.

- Forte comprensione dei principi di CRM, clientela e impegno dei clienti.

- Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale e navi a bordo.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business performance and delivering integrated, objective, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

As a key member of the Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics team, he/she will have the opportunity to work with large-scale datasets and advanced technologies, developing deep expertise in the core business. To succeed in this role, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst must have a strong passion for data analysis, reporting, and uncovering meaningful insights. The role requires the ability to interpret complex information, assess business implications, and provide impactful recommendations that drive revenue growth and improve overall business performance.

Your Impact

Reporting directly to the Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for:

- Supporting the full lifecycle of the budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring the delivery of accurate and timely analyses.

- Partnering with business stakeholders to identify needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.

- Gathering, documenting, and maintaining data requirements to support both recurring and ad hoc business analyses.

- Developing expertise across multiple data sources and business domains to generate meaningful insights and drive informed decision-making.

- Collaborating with vendors, third-party providers, and cross-functional corporate teams in a dynamic and agile environment.

- Contributing to the continuous enhancement of analytical frameworks, reporting capabilities, and data-driven business processes.

Data Analysis and Insights. Main activities include:

- QA data to ensure accuracy

- Analyze and mine data to find opportunities in time allotted

- Undertake proactive and reactive ad-hoc requests as needed

- Make business recommendations based on the data findings

- Drive more efficient and sophisticated analytical insights

Analysis Distribution. Main activities include:

- Design effective and impactful reports and visualizations for both large and small scale distribution

- Create presentations to highlight recommendations and tell the story

- Ensure partners understand the analysis presented

Analytical Innovation. Main activities include:

- Drive efficiencies to current processes through tools and processes

- Increase the level of sophistication of analyses through statistical, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques

Your Journey so far

- Four plus years of relevant experience in a fast paced, rapidly changing operations environment

- Experience with “big data” environments and tool

- Experience data and analytics

- Experience with budgeting and forecasting processes

- Bachelor’s in mathematics, business administration or IT

Your Essentials

- Fluent English (Knowledge of a second European language is preferred but not essential)

- Excellent analytical skills.

- Previous experience in Revenue Management is essential, possibly in the tourism industry.

- Ability to build business cases from analysis to be sold to senior management, including Chief Revenue Management and Sales, Executive Directors and CEO.

- Strong problem solving and decision-making attitude.

- Experience with analytics tools (PYTHON, SAP, ZENZ, QLIK SENSE) would be a strong advantage

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst è responsabile dell'analisi delle prestazioni aziendali e della fornitura di informazioni integrate, oggettive e attuabili per supportare il processo decisionale strategico.

Come membro chiave del team Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics, avrà l'opportunità di lavorare con set di dati su larga scala e tecnologie avanzate, sviluppando competenze approfondite nel core business. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, il Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst deve avere una forte passione per l'analisi dei dati, la segnalazione e la scoperta di approfondimenti significativi. Il ruolo richiede la capacità di interpretare informazioni complesse, valutare le implicazioni aziendali, e fornire raccomandazioni impellenti che spingono la crescita del fatturato e migliorare le prestazioni aziendali globali.

Il tuo impatto

Segnalandosi direttamente al Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, l'Analista senior per la gestione delle entrate sarà responsabile per:

- Sostenere il ciclo di vita completo dei processi di bilancio e di previsione, garantendo la consegna di analisi accurate e tempestive.

- Collaborare con gli stakeholder aziendali per identificare le esigenze, definire i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni analitiche attuabili.

- Raccogliere, documentare e mantenere i requisiti di dati per supportare analisi aziendali ricorrenti e ad hoc.

- Sviluppare competenze attraverso più fonti di dati e domini aziendali per generare intuizioni significative e guidare il processo decisionale informato.

- Collaborare con fornitori, fornitori di terze parti e team aziendali interfunzionali in un ambiente dinamico e agile.

- Contribuire al continuo miglioramento dei quadri analitici, delle capacità di reporting e dei processi aziendali basati sui dati.

Analisi dei dati e Insights. Le attività principali includono:

- Dati QA per garantire la precisione

- Analizzare e analizzare i dati delle mine per trovare opportunità nel tempo assegnato

- Sottoporre richieste adhoc proattive e reattive come necessario

- Fare raccomandazioni aziendali in base ai risultati dei dati

- Guidare approfondimenti analitici più efficienti e sofisticati

Analisi Distribuzione. Le attività principali includono:

- Progettare report e visualizzazioni efficaci e di impatto per la distribuzione su larga scala

- Creare presentazioni per evidenziare raccomandazioni e raccontare la storia

- Assicurare ai partner di comprendere l'analisi presentata

Innovazione analitica. Le attività principali includono:

- Guidare le efficienze ai processi attuali attraverso strumenti e processi

- Aumentare il livello di sofisticazione delle analisi attraverso le tecniche statistiche, di machine learning e di intelligenza artificiale

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Quattro anni più di esperienza rilevante in un ambiente operativo veloce e in rapida evoluzione

- Esperienza con ambienti e strumenti “grandi dati”

- Esperienza dei dati e analisi

- Esperienza con processi di budget e previsioni

- Bachelor in matematica, amministrazione aziendale o IT

I tuoi essenziali

- Inglese fluente (La conoscenza di una seconda lingua europea è preferita ma non essenziale)

- Eccellente capacità analitiche.

- Esperienza precedente in Revenue Management è essenziale, possibilmente nel settore del turismo.

- Capacità di costruire casi di business dall'analisi da vendere alla gestione senior, tra cui gestione delle entrate e vendite, amministratori e CEO.

- Forte problem solving e atteggiamento decisionale.

- L'esperienza con strumenti di analisi (PYTHON, SAP, ZENZ, QLIK SENSE) sarebbe un vantaggio forte

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Der Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst ist dafür verantwortlich, die Geschäftsleistung zu analysieren und integrierte, objektive und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zur Unterstützung der strategischen Entscheidungsfindung zu liefern.

Als wichtiges Mitglied des Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics-Teams hat er die Möglichkeit, mit umfangreichen Datensätzen und fortschrittlichen Technologien zu arbeiten und fundiertes Know-how im Kerngeschäft zu entwickeln. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, muss der Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst eine starke Leidenschaft für Datenanalyse, Reporting und die Aufdeckung sinnvoller Erkenntnisse haben. Die Rolle erfordert die Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen zu interpretieren, geschäftliche Auswirkungen zu bewerten und wirkungsvolle Empfehlungen zu geben, die das Umsatzwachstum vorantreiben und die allgemeine Geschäftsleistung verbessern.

Direkte Berichterstattung an den Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, der Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst ist verantwortlich für:

- Unterstützung des gesamten Lebenszyklus der Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozesse und Gewährleistung der Bereitstellung genauer und zeitnaher Analysen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit geschäftlichen Stakeholdern, um Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren, Anforderungen zu definieren und sie in umsetzbare analytische Lösungen umzusetzen.

- Sammeln, Dokumentieren und Pflegen von Datenanforderungen, um sowohl wiederkehrende als auch Ad-hoc-Geschäftsanalysen zu unterstützen.

- Entwicklung von Fachwissen über mehrere Datenquellen und Geschäftsdomänen hinweg, um aussagekräftige Erkenntnisse zu generieren und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit Anbietern, Drittanbietern und funktionsübergreifenden Unternehmensteams in einer dynamischen und agilen Umgebung.

- Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von analytischen Frameworks, Berichtsfunktionen und datengesteuerten Geschäftsprozessen.

Datenanalyse und Insights. Zu den Hauptaktivitäten gehören:

- QA-Daten zur Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit

- Analysieren und Minen von Daten, um Chancen in der vorgegebenen Zeit zu finden

- Proaktive und reaktive Ad-hoc-Anfragen nach Bedarf

- Machen Sie Geschäftsempfehlungen basierend auf den Datenergebnissen

- Effizientere und ausgefeiltere analytische Erkenntnisse

- Entwerfen Sie effektive und wirkungsvolle Berichte und Visualisierungen für große und kleine Verteilungen

- Erstellen Sie Präsentationen, um Empfehlungen hervorzuheben und die Geschichte zu erzählen

- Steigerung der Effizienz aktueller Prozesse durch Tools und Prozesse

- Erhöhen Sie den Grad der Raffinesse der Analysen durch statistische, maschinelles Lernen und künstliche Intelligenz Techniken

- Erfahrungsdaten und Analysen

- Erfahrung mit Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozessen

- Fließendes Englisch (Kenntnisse einer zweiten europäischen Sprache sind bevorzugt, aber nicht unbedingt erforderlich)

- Frühere Erfahrungen im Revenue Management sind unerlässlich, möglicherweise in der Tourismusbranche.

- Fähigkeit, Business Cases aus Analysen zu erstellen, die an die Geschäftsleitung verkauft werden, einschließlich Chief Revenue Management und Sales, Executive Directors und CEO.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Category is the global business owner for the Watches & Jewelry category across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the global category strategy, driving commercial performance, developing a world-class assortment, and building long-term partnerships with leading watch and jewelry maisons.

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

Commercial Performance

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

Product Development & Assortment Management

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

Brand Partnerships

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Watches & Jewelry merchandising team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

Your Journey so far

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury watches and jewelry markets, trends and consumer behavior.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen with excellent analytical skills.

- Proven ability to negotiate and build long-term strategic supplier partnerships.

- Excellent understanding of merchandising principles, assortment architecture and inventory optimization.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Passion for luxury retail and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Willingness to travel internationally.

Our commitment

Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Jewelry Product Development Senior Manager is responsible for transforming creative concepts into commercially successful jewelry collections across MSC Cruises. Working closely with the in-house Jewelry Designer, the Head of Watches & Jewelry, industrial partners and suppliers, the role leads the end-to-end product development process from concept validation through industrialization and market launch while ensuring each collection is commercially balanced, technically feasible, financially viable and aligned with the positioning of each cruise brand. The role combines creativity, product expertise and industrial know-how to build distinctive jewelry collections that strengthen the Group's exclusive retail offering.

Your Impact

Collection Development

- Lead the end to end development of exclusive jewelry collections from concept to launch.

- Translate creative vision into commercially successful products while preserving design integrity.

- Build structured collections with balanced product architecture, pricing, materials, and customer segments.

- Identify portfolio gaps and propose new product opportunities.

- Maintain collection freshness through seasonal updates, new launches, and limited editions.

Supplier & Industrial Partner Management

- Find suppliers and manage relationships with jewelry manufacturers and production partners.

- Identify and onboard new suppliers to support growth and innovation.

- Evaluate suppliers based on quality, craftsmanship, innovation, capacity, ethical sourcing, and competitiveness.

- Facilitate technical collaboration between designers and manufacturers.

- Support supplier negotiations with Procurement.

Collection Architecture & Portfolio Management

- Continuously assess the strength and completeness of the fashion jewelry portfolio.

- Maintain balanced representation across categories, materials, gemstones, finishes, and price points.

- Analyze sales and customer insights to identify assortment opportunities.

- Recommend portfolio rationalization to improve productivity.

- Develop long term collection roadmaps aligned with brand strategy.

Product Development

- Manage the product development calendar and critical path.

- Coordinate prototypes, technical drawings, sampling, approvals, and production readiness.

- Ensure products meet quality, cost, timing, and commercial targets.

- Monitor product performance throughout its lifecycle and drive improvements.

- Support collection launches across the network.

Quality & Product Excellence

- Ensure all products meet quality, regulatory, and brand standards.

- Coordinate testing, validation, and production approvals.

- Partner with Quality teams to resolve issues and improve product performance.

- Maintain exceptional craftsmanship across all collections.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner with the Jewelry Designer throughout the creative process.

- Align product development with category strategy alongside the Head of Watches & Jewelry.

- Collaborate with Retail Operations to maximize commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to optimize inventory levels.

- Partner with Performance teams to monitor profitability and investment returns.

- Coordinate effectively with cross functional stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution.

Innovation

- Monitor jewelry trends, materials, manufacturing techniques, and consumer preferences.

- Explore new materials, gemstones, finishes, and production technologies.

- Benchmark competitors and identify differentiation opportunities.

- Drive innovation while maintaining commercial and operational viability.

Your Journey so far

- 8+ years of experience in jewelry product development, collection management or product management, ideally in the Contemporary Jewellery space

- Experience working with jewelry manufacturers and production partners.

- Strong understanding of jewelry manufacturing processes, materials and craftsmanship.

- Experience managing product development calendars and supplier coordination.

- Experience within luxury jewelry is highly desirable.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of jewelry product development from concept to production.

- Strong knowledge of manufacturing techniques, materials and quality standards.

- Excellent project management and organizational skills.

- Commercial awareness with the ability to balance creativity and profitability.

- Strong analytical skills and understanding of collection architecture.

- Excellent communication and relationship management capabilities.

- Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders across creative, technical and commercial functions.

- Passion for luxury jewelry and product innovation.

- Willingness to travel internationally to suppliers and manufacturing partners.

Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Are you passionate about shaping extraordinary private destinations where design, nature, and hospitality come together to create unforgettable guest experiences?

Do you bring hands-on expertise in theme parks, resorts, or island experiences and the analytical mindset to transform complex operational challenges into seamless, high-impact holiday moments?

Your Impact

MSC Cruises is seeking a Sr Director of Product Innovation with expertise in hospitality, F&B and resort development. In this role, you will define the future of engaging, imaginative, and operationally feasible destinations. You will combine strategic insight, creative thinking, and operational expertise to design environments that delight our guests.

You’ll partner closely with brand, development, design, technical, and operational teams to translate complex requirements into actionable plans. Using operational insights, industry trends, and sustainable development principles, you will shape concepts that balance feasibility, innovation, and guest experience.

If you thrive at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and operational leadership and enjoy turning visionary concepts into tangible, memorable holiday experiences, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Journey so far

- Lead the ideation and conceptual development of private destinations, defining objectives, master planning, operational parameters, and technical constraints.

- Collaborate with design, development, operations, F&B, logistics, and technical teams to translate vision into clear, actionable plans.

- Analyse operational insights, industry trends, guest expectations, and competitive offerings to guide concept refinement, decision-making, and KPI setting.

- Engage and align multiple stakeholders across regions, providing guidance on priorities, feasibility, and strategic objectives.

- Contribute to long-term roadmaps for private destinations and resort experiences, ensuring alignment with brand vision and guest experience goals.

- Prepare compelling presentations and documentation to communicate rationale, operational requirements, and recommendations to senior leadership.

- Ensure all proposed concepts adhere to health, safety, environmental, and regulatory standards.

Your Essentials

- 10-15 years of experience in experiential design, destination/resort management with port/cruise operations management a plus.

- Strong operational knowledge of cruise industry logistics, hotel development, port operations, and technical requirements.

- Ability to translate complex operational and technical requirements into clear, actionable concepts.

- Understanding of architectural, design, or engineering principles is a plus.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate and align cross-functional and multicultural teams.

- Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills; able to assess feasibility, operational impact, and guest experience implications.

- Strong communication and presentation skills, able to convey complex ideas to senior and executive leadership.

- Agile, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Passion for delivering operationally feasible, guest-focused innovations.

-

MSC Cruises sucht einen Senior Director of Product Innovation mit Expertise in den Bereichen Hospitality, F&B und Resortentwicklung. In dieser Rolle definieren Sie die Zukunft der ansprechenden, phantasievollen und operativ machbaren Ziele. Sie kombinieren strategische Erkenntnisse, kreatives Denken und operatives Know-how, um Umgebungen zu entwerfen, die unsere Gäste begeistern.

Sie arbeiten eng mit Marken-, Entwicklungs-, Design-, technischen und operativen Teams zusammen, um komplexe Anforderungen in umsetzbare Pläne zu übersetzen. Mit operativen Erkenntnissen, Branchentrends und Prinzipien der nachhaltigen Entwicklung gestalten Sie Konzepte, die Machbarkeit, Innovation und Gästeerfahrung in Einklang bringen.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery is responsible for bringing the next generation of guest experiences to life across MSC Cruises' new class of ships.
Working closely with the Product Innovation team, this role transforms approved concepts into fully realized onboard experiences, ensuring they are operationally executable, commercially successful, and aligned with the MSC Cruises brand.
Leading the development and delivery of end-to-end guest journeys, service concepts, and onboard experiences, the Sr. Director ensures every experience is launch-ready from ship design and operational planning to crew delivery and guest activation.
The role also plays a key part in defining how new experiences are presented to guests, partnering with internal teams to shape compelling storytelling, positioning, and go-to-market strategies that maximize guest engagement and commercial impact.
As a trusted partner to senior leadership, the Sr. Director regularly presents progress, recommendations, and delivery strategies to executive stakeholders, including the CEO and Chairman, ensuring alignment from concept approval through successful launch.

Your Impact

Experience Development & Delivery

-
Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new guest experiences, from approved concept through ship launch.

-
Translate approved concepts into guest journeys, service models, operational requirements, and launch plans.

-
Ensure every experience remains true to the original vision while being operationally feasible, commercially successful, and aligned with MSC Cruises' brand standards.

Guest Experience Excellence

-
Champion guest-centric experiences that combine hospitality, storytelling, service excellence, and commercial performance.

-
Design memorable end-to-end guest journeys that create emotional engagement and enhance guest satisfaction.

-
Apply industry best practices and continuous innovation to elevate onboard experiences across the fleet.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-
Lead collaboration across Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architects, designers, and external partners to successfully deliver new guest experiences.

-
Ensure alignment between ship design, construction milestones, operational readiness, and launch activities.

-
Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Project & Delivery Management

-
Oversee project plans, budgets, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.

-
Support the SVP with budget oversight, executive reporting, strategic recommendations, and delivery governance.

-
Ensure projects are properly planned, resourced, and delivered on time, within scope, and in line with business objectives.

Executive Communication

-
Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and project updates for senior leadership, including the CEO and Chairman.

-
Clearly communicate delivery progress, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.

-
Support executive decision-making with data-driven insights, operational considerations, and guest experience perspectives.

Team Leadership

-
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of guest experience professionals.

-
Build capabilities in guest journey design, hospitality delivery, stakeholder management, project execution, and operational integration.

-
Foster a collaborative, accountable, innovative, and guest-first culture while developing future leadership talent.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

-
Define, monitor, and report KPIs related to launch readiness, guest satisfaction, operational adoption, experience quality, and commercial performance.

-
Lead post-launch evaluations, capture lessons learned, and implement continuous improvements to strengthen future experience delivery.

-
Drive a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across all guest experience development activities.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

- 12+ years of experience in designing and delivering physical, in-space guest experiences within hospitality, cruise ships, resorts, themed entertainment, or similar service-driven environments, with a clear focus on onboard or on-site experiences rather than digital products.

- Proven track record of leading large-scale, guest-facing physical experience projects from concept through implementation in complex operational environments such as ships, hotels, or resorts.

- Strong understanding of physical guest experience design, hospitality operations, service excellence, and in-person customer journey development within built environments.

- Demonstrated ability to translate strategic concepts into operationally executable, tangible experiences and launch plans within physical spaces.

- Experienced leader with a proven ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing, cross-functional teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

- Strong commercial, financial, and analytical mindset, balancing guest experience, operational feasibility, timelines, and investment.

- Experience collaborating with designers, architects, creative agencies, and operational teams to deliver immersive, physical environments and experiences.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) and presentation tools to develop compelling concepts and executive communications focused on physical experience delivery.

- Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally up to 30%.

Your Essentials

-

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
